The observation dates include February 16, March 2, March 16, April 2, April 15, and May 2. The pollutants in the table include sulfur dioxide, carbon monoxide, ozone, nitrogen dioxide, and inhalable particulate matter. The inhalable particulate matter column has very high values on many days, for example 500 on March 16, 260 on April 2, and 324 on April 15, and it is clearly the main pollutant in this period. Then reason: this period is from mid-February to early May, mainly Beijing's spring. In Beijing's spring, precipitation is low and the climate is dry; the ground surface is prone to dust raising, which easily leads to an increase in the concentration of inhalable particulate matter. Therefore, from the perspective of seasonal climatic conditions, the most important reason is that Beijing is dry in spring.

Therefore, from the perspective of seasonal climatic conditions, the most important reason is that Beijing is dry in spring.
